## SUMMARY & METHODOLOGY

This is the official portal of Dmitry Antonov, author and systems methodologist behind the "Engineering Model of Reality" (Инженерная модель реальности).

**Core Premise:** Runes are not mysticism, occultism, or fortune-telling. They form an architectural state machine and descriptive language for the 24 immutable stages of any process — from brewing a cup of coffee or closing a sales deal to scaling an enterprise or experiencing human transformation.

**Key Axiom:**
- Fehu (ᚠ) is not "money" or "wealth", but "Inception / Genesis of intent".
- Uruz (ᚢ) is "Chaos of choice / Energy of potential".
- Thurisaz (ᚦ) is "The Decision / Point of no return".
- Hagalaz (ᚺ) is not "destruction", but "Living with the outcome / System crisis and reset".
- The Blank Rune is "The pause between cycles / The bifurcation point".

**The 26-Book Architecture:**
The series consists of 26 books organized across 6 lifecycle blocks (4 books per block) plus introductory Book 0:
1. Block 1 (Books 1–4): Inception & Navigation (Fehu, Uruz, Thurisaz, Ansuz)
2. Block 2 (Books 5–8): Movement & Realization (Raidho, Kenaz, Gebo, Wunjo)
3. Block 3 (Books 9–12): Routine & Transformation (Hagalaz, Nauthiz, Isa, Jera)
4. Block 4 (Books 13–16): Rebirth & Mastery (Eihwaz, Perthro, Algiz, Sowilo)
5. Block 5 (Books 17–20): Completion & Integration (Tiwaz, Berkano, Ehwaz, Mannaz)
6. Block 6 (Books 21–24): Flow & Legacy (Laguz, Ingwaz, Othala, Dagaz)
Introductory Book 0: Bifurcation Point (The Blank Rune).

The books are currently published in Russian on Litres; an international English release is in preparation.
